details: Bitcoin surged past $77,000, reaching highs since May, driven by the U.S. Treasury's plan to increase long-dated bond buybacks to lower yields and boost market liquidity. This dovetailed with President Trump's advocacy for the "Clarity Act" to establish clear crypto regulations, enhancing institutional confidence. Concurrently, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw substantial inflows, totaling over $1.6 billion this week, signaling robust institutional demand.
title: US Treasury Moves, Trump's Crypto Support Fuel Bitcoin Rally & ETF Inflows

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has revised down its 2026 global economic growth projection to 3.0% from 3.1%, citing the persistent fallout from the Middle East conflict. This geopolitical tension is expected to extend commodity price volatility, disrupt supply chains, and accelerate global inflation to an anticipated 4.7% for the year. While an AI boom offers some offset, the overall outlook suggests slower growth.
title: IMF Cuts 2026 Global Growth Forecast Amid Middle East War & Inflation Concerns

details: European Central Bank (ECB) policymaker Mārtiņš Kazāks indicated a cautious approach ahead of the September policy decision. While inflation expectations remain anchored by slowing wage growth, the outlook is complicated by ongoing geopolitical developments and energy market volatility. Money markets are bracing for a potentially more hawkish ECB, anticipating a rate hike in September to combat persistent inflation pressures.
title: ECB Policymaker Signals Cautious Stance Amid Geopolitical Uncertainty
